summary: Completed testing of OurCircle Phase 2 with all 10 UI layouts. Backend APIs working excellently (96.6% success rate). Frontend core functionality working but session management issues prevent complete testing of all features.

ui_bugs.issue: Session expires frequently, causing redirects back to PIN entry page during navigation
Family creation shows success but data doesn't persist consistently across page refreshes

integration_issues.issue: Cannot reliably navigate to Settings page due to session expiration
Unable to test layout switching functionality due to session management issues

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix session management issues in frontend authentication. Sessions expire too quickly causing frequent redirects to PIN entry. This prevents testing of Settings page, layout switching, and child dossier features. Also investigate family data persistence issues.
